ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-1 in
the area bound by:

West Fifth Avenue; a line 125 feet northeast of and parallel to South Whipple Street, the
alley next south of and parallel West Fifth Avenue; and, a line 36.3 feet southwest of and
parallel to South Whipple Street

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

i

Cc. Ervin
ran 28" Ward

Common Address:
3023 — 43 West Fifth Avenue
